old_description: Welcome to Chicago Medical Engineering, your premier destination for all your Capital Equipment, Imaging Equipment, and medical equipment service and sales needs. We are a complete Clinical and Diagnostic Turn Key Solution Provider. We specialize in hospital furniture and equipment, primarily focusing on cutting-edge Imaging Capital Equipment. Understanding the marketing gap and importance Importance of Calibrated Medical Equipment with Performing Results, we have quickly become a trusted name in the healthcare industry.
about:
Chicago Medical Engineering is based in Elmhurst, Illinois. The company was founded in 2019 by a team of engineers who recognized the importance of calibrated, high-performing medical imaging equipment. They set out to fill a market gap for reliable, turnkey solutions in capital medical equipment.

The company supplies pre-owned medical imaging systems and parts through a catalog of more than 1,190 items across 16 equipment categories, including CT scanners, MRI systems, cath/angio labs, portable X-ray units, ultrasound transducers, digital mammography units, and linear accelerators. In addition to sales and leasing, Chicago Medical Engineering provides comprehensive service and maintenance for imaging and radiation therapy equipment. Its engineers perform preventive maintenance, emergency repairs, calibration, compliance assurance, installation, de-installation, and refurbishment. The firm also offers project coordination, asset management, and regulatory documentation support.

Customers include hospitals, outpatient diagnostic centers, radiation therapy clinics, and radiology departments worldwide. The company cites work with radiation oncology directors, healthcare procurement executives, and lead biomedical engineers who rely on its technical data accuracy and responsive support for complex machinery such as Varian TrueBeam linear accelerators.

Chicago Medical Engineering was started to address the need for calibrated medical equipment that delivers consistent results. The company emphasizes end-to-end project coordination, a global network of vendor-certified engineers (including Varian, GE, Siemens, Philips, Toshiba, and Medtronic), and adherence to standards such as The Joint Commission, DNV Healthcare, and NFPA 99. The team’s combined 80 years of experience underpins its approach to reducing downtime and extending asset lifecycles.

name: Chilton Furniture
old_description: We offer a unique collection of designs celebrating natural materials, New England aesthetics, and quality craftsmanship.
about:
Chilton Furniture, based in Portland, Maine, traces its origins to 1885 when the Chilton Paint Co. began manufacturing paints, varnishes, and industrial coatings in Portland, Boston, and New York. The business was acquired by the Martens family in 1936, shifting to stains and finishes for furniture makers. In the 1970s, the company added unfinished pine furniture at its Exchange Street location. The Levin family took ownership in 2014, refocusing the brand on exclusive furniture designs crafted from domestically sourced North American hardwoods. Today, Chilton operates as a family-owned furniture brand with a flagship showroom in Portland and a second location in Freeport.

The company designs and sells a range of hardwood furniture—including seating, tables, storage, beds, and accessories—using cherry, maple, walnut, and white oak sourced in the United States. Production is carried out by a network of independent makers in Maine and the Midwest, with Chilton coordinating design, material sourcing, and quality assurance. The brand offers a lifetime warranty to the original owner and provides nationwide delivery for its products.

Chilton serves both retail customers and trade professionals through a dedicated trade partner program that extends discounts and benefits to interior designers and architects. Customer reviews highlight the company’s personal service and the ability to purchase without seeing pieces in person. The brand’s aesthetic centers on New England traditions and natural materials.

The Levin family’s acquisition was driven by a desire to honor Chilton Manufacturing Co.’s legacy while committing to the highest quality and paying tribute to New England’s history. The company emphasizes that its furniture is handmade in the USA from premium natural materials, positioning itself as a steward of enduring craftsmanship.

name: Cincinnati Wood Collaborative
old_description: We have been accredited by the BBB since 2018 and strive to maintain the principles of quality, value, and integrity, and to practice these principles in all our affairs.
about:
Cincinnati Wood Collaborative was founded in 2018 in Cincinnati, Ohio. The company operates as a local woodworking shop focused on custom projects for commercial and residential clients.

The shop provides custom woodworking for builds and renovations of any size, specializing in complete millwork packages for restaurants, bars, and breweries. Work is performed using sustainable, locally sourced wood from certified Master Logging Companies that meet Ohio Forestry Association standards, ensuring responsible forestry practices and proper timber harvesting techniques that maintain forest integrity.

Its primary customers are in the hospitality sector, including restaurant, bar, and brewery operators seeking custom millwork for new builds or renovations. The company also collaborates with other small businesses in the Cincinnati area, sourcing materials locally and fostering a community-oriented supply chain.

The business emphasizes responsible forestry practices and local sourcing, maintaining BBB accreditation since its founding year. Its approach centers on quality craftsmanship, value, and integrity, with a commitment to supporting the regional ecosystem and economy through sustainable material choices and local partnerships.

name: Cinnamon Metals
old_description: Serving commercial and residential Roofing, Masonry, and Green Roofing Contractors
about:
Cinnamon Metals was founded in 2005 when a roofing contractor in Manassas, Virginia, began fabricating sheet metal in his home garage with the help of his wife, Cinnamon, to avoid weeks-long lead times on simple orders. The operation grew steadily, formally establishing as Cinnamon Metals and relocating to a dedicated shop in Springfield, Virginia, in July 2014.

The company provides full-service custom metal fabrication with a focus on roofing, green roofing, and masonry products. Its equipment lineup includes a shear and computerized brake (added 2010), a CNC turret punch (2019), a CNC press brake (2020), and laser welding capabilities (2021). In-house services cover 3D product design, shop drawings, cut sheets, and manufacturing consulting to optimize cost and lead time.

Cinnamon Metals serves commercial and residential roofing contractors, masonry contractors, green roofing specialists, as well as landscaping and general construction firms. Its product range spans metal panels, water control systems, masonry flashings, and green roofing edging designed for compatibility with common assemblies.

The business was born from the need for quick, reliable, and quality fabrication. Today it differentiates itself as an authorized fabricator meeting ANSI/SPRI ES-1 standards and a member of the National Roofing Contractors Association, offering design support and consulting alongside fabrication.

about:
Circle City Metalworks operates from the Irvington neighborhood on the east side of Indianapolis, Indiana. The shop was founded in 2020 and is run by Ryan Mullin, who writes the company's blog and refers to the business as "our little metal shop."

The company provides custom metal fabrication services including design, plasma cutting, welding, painting, and installation. Its portfolio spans custom handrails, tables, address signs, security products, and apartment-complex signage. A 2024 blog post notes the firm's largest project to date: fabricating and installing components for Southport High School in Perry Township.

Customers range from homeowners seeking one-off pieces to commercial contractors and educational institutions. Residential clients order handrails and decorative signs, while apartment complexes and schools commission larger structural and signage packages. The shop also markets a line of security-oriented metal products.

Circle City Metalworks positions itself on the promise "You dream it, we make it," emphasizing turnkey custom work from concept through installation. The team highlights its ability to scale from small decorative items to a high-school campus project as evidence of its flexibility.

old_description: Get Amped Up For Unbeatable Deals – Buy And Sell Your Electrical Items With Us Today!
about:
Circuit Breaker Source operates from Norco, California, and was founded in 2015. The company presents itself as a buyer and seller of electrical equipment with over 15 years of industry experience, though no individual founders are named and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The business buys and sells new, used, surplus, and obsolete circuit breakers — including molded case, low-voltage, air, vacuum, insulated case, and panelboard types — along with transformers, panels, safety switches, motor control equipment, and isolator switches. It also provides repair and testing, refurbishing, upgrade and design, supply and replacement, and emergency response services. No facility size, headcount, or transaction volumes are published.

Customers include electrical contractors with leftover project material, distributors with slow-moving or discontinued stock, industrial facilities undergoing modernization, and construction companies with surplus inventory. The company evaluates single breakers or bulk lots, requesting nameplate photos, manufacturer, model, ratings, quantity, condition, and location to make offers.

The company states its vision is to lead the industry with quality products, services, and innovative solutions, and its mission is to provide safe electrical equipment and create a sustainable supply chain. It notes it is certified by state and federal law, though no specific standards are cited.

name: Circuit Design Specialties Inc.
old_description: Best Circuit Design in the industry. Unparalleled craftsmanship & attention to detail.
about:
Circuit Design Specialties operates from Plano, Texas, where it was founded over three decades ago by Randel Stewart, who remains chief executive. The company is woman-owned and has built a reputation for electronic and mechanical assembly services across industrial, medical, and military sectors.

The shop provides a full suite of electronics manufacturing services, including PCB layout, fabrication, and assembly, as well as cable and wiring harness production, box-build integration, and new-product development from concept through prototype to volume production. Its engineering team handles high-layer-count, rigid-flex, and impedance-controlled designs, while the assembly floor manages component procurement, inspection, and final test.

Customers range from small businesses to large enterprises in the industrial, medical, military, and government markets. The company cites experience building cable assemblies for military and medical applications and has served hundreds of clients across the United States over its history.

CDS differentiates itself by combining design and manufacturing under one roof, which it says yields significant cost savings over traditional contract engineering firms and enables design-for-manufacturability, testability, and faster design cycles. All work is performed in the United States.

The company stocks over 1,200 packaging products across categories that include plastic bottles and jars, glass bottles and jars, metal containers such as aluminum bottles and tins, and a wide range of closures including continuous-thread caps, dispensing caps, metal caps, and child-resistant caps. The company emphasizes personal service — “Real people. Real service.” — offering free samples on every product page, direct access to packaging specialists for bulk orders, and a commitment to helping customers find the right container and closure combinations.

about:
Clarus Medical operates from Minneapolis, Minnesota, where it has spent more than three decades designing and manufacturing small-diameter medical endoscopes. The company does not disclose a specific founding year or ownership structure in its public materials.

The company produces a range of medical devices including airway and intubation scopes, minimally invasive spine instruments, inspection borescopes, and neuroendoscopy systems. It also provides private-label and OEM manufacturing services for other medical companies. All products are built in an ISO 13485 certified cleanroom, though the facility’s square footage and employee count are not publicly specified.

Clarus Medical serves the medical device industry, supplying both its own branded endoscopes and acting as an OEM partner for other medical technology firms. Its customer base includes hospitals, surgical centers, and medical device manufacturers seeking precision small-diameter optics.

The company states its mission is to create devices that assist in saving lives, minimizing patient trauma, and reducing medical costs. Its marketing emphasizes precision in small-diameter optics, summarized by the tagline “Small Devices, Big Results.”

about:
Classic Plastics Corporation operates from Shorewood, Illinois. The company has more than 30 years of experience in polymer engineering and custom plastics fabrication, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided in available sources.

The company specializes in custom plastics manufacturing, with a focus on body bags and mortuary supplies for death care, healthcare, and public safety sectors. Its capabilities include custom fabrication and tooling, advanced material processing, in-house printing, fulfillment, and private label services. Materials worked include vinyl, polypropylene, polyethylene, and bioplastics derived from corn and tapioca starches. Custom orders typically require a minimum of 1,000 pieces, while stock items ship within one to two business days. Facility size and employee count are not disclosed.

Classic Plastics serves the death care, healthcare, medical and scientific, government and public safety, and veterinary industries. Its B2B clients include coroners, medical examiners, police and fire departments, the U.S. Army, hospitals, morgues, anatomy labs, organ and tissue donor networks, funeral homes, funeral supply distributors, veterinary hospitals, and wildlife and farm management facilities.

The company emphasizes its vertically integrated model, combining custom fabrication, printing, and fulfillment under one roof to deliver spec-driven products for compliance-heavy industries. It also highlights its pioneering work in custom bioplastics, offering chlorine-free, "Burn Wise" compliant options for cremation and alkaline hydrolysis.
